468: def _controller_startup_scope(choice, caller_root, *, usage, root_kind):
469:     """Retain accepted controller input before the still-closed worker seam.
470: 
471:     No acquisition, worker start or model constructor is called here. Once a
472:     native permit is reserved, an unfinished scope remains quarantined under
473:     the existing exception-aware lifecycle; it never invents no-worker cleanup.
474:     """
475:     configured = _startup_configuration()
476:     authority, trusted, selected, store, snapshot = _STARTUP_RELEASE(choice, caller_root, root_kind=root_kind)
477:     _require(authority is configured, "Startup release changed during selection")
478:     profile = _STARTUP_PROFILE(authority, usage)
479:     manager, factory = SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE, RUNTIME_FACTORY
480:     _require(type(manager) is DurableSnapshotLifecycle and type(factory) is DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory
481:              and factory.manager is manager, "Exact durable startup lifecycle and factory required")
482:     custody = _StartupCustody(authority, trusted, selected, profile, usage, manager, factory)
483:     # Custody starts before any lease/admission/binding operation can fail.
484:     _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS[id(custody)] = custody
485:     try:
486:         # Retain the lease wrapper before entry can reserve protection.
487:         custody.lease = manager.read_lease(str(store), choice, selected.revision)
488:         _require(type(custody.lease) is _DurableLease and custody.lease.manager is manager,
489:                  "Exact issued durable lease required")
490:         with custody.lease:
491:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
492:             custody.admission = _STARTUP_ADMIT(trusted, choice, store, snapshot)
493:             admitted = custody.admission
494:             _require(type(admitted) is resolver.Admission and type(admitted.manifest) is resolver.TrustedManifest
495:                      and admitted.manifest == trusted and admitted.manifest.approval is authority.manifest_approval
496:                      and admitted.choice == choice and admitted.snapshot == str(snapshot)
497:                      and admitted.private_root == str(store), "Exact successful selected admission required")
498:             # Admission reparses the manifest; retain its exact selected object,
499:             # while retaining the initial approved manifest separately.
500:             custody.selected = next(model for model in admitted.manifest.models if model.choice == choice)
501:             _require(custody.selected == selected, "Admission selected a different model")
502:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
503:             custody.permit = custody.lease.begin_native_session()
504:             custody.record = custody.permit.record
505:             custody.key = custody.record.key
506:             custody.protection = custody.record.protection
507:             custody.token = custody.lease.token
508:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
509:             custody.binding = _STARTUP_BIND(admitted)
510:             b = custody.binding
511:             _require(type(b) is resolver.LocalBinding and b.choice == choice
512:                      and b.revision == custody.selected.revision
513:                      and b.manifest_sha256 == authority.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256
514:                      and b.model_path == admitted.snapshot and b.files == admitted.files
515:                      and b.local_files_only is True and b.constructor_called is False
516:                      and b.real_runtime_approved is False, "Exact rechecked local startup binding required")
517:             startup = _ControllerASRStart(authority, authority.manifest_approval, trusted,
518:                 admitted, custody.selected, profile, usage, b, custody.permit)
519:             custody.startup = startup
520:             custody.references, custody.values = _startup_references(custody), _startup_values(custody)
521:             _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS[id(startup)] = custody
522:             _validate_controller_startup(startup, custody.permit)
523:             try:
524:                 yield startup
525:             finally:
526:                 with manager._lock:
527:                     custody.active = False
528:     except BaseException as original:
529:         custody.primary_error = original
530:         raise
531:     finally:
532:         custody.active = False
533:         # A failed/reserved attempt remains retained. It is never converted to
534:         # completion by removing Python references or by a recorded digest.
535:         record = custody.lease.inner._record if type(custody.lease) is _DurableLease else None
536:         if record is not None and record.phase is Phase.RELEASED:
537:             _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS.pop(id(custody), None)
